title: Classic American Chicken Casserole
description: A comforting and satisfying casserole filled with juicy chicken, creamy sauce, and a crunchy topping. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Cook the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the onion and garlic until softened. Add the cream of chicken soup and stir until combined.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir until coated with the soup mixture.
In a separate bowl, combine the milk and shredded cheese. Stir until smooth.
Add the cheese mixture to the skillet with the chicken and soup mixture. Stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the crushed crackers over the top of the casserole.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is hot and the crackers are golden brown.
